task.description:
Run the EE-05 test suite and produce a structured test report.

1. Run `zig build test` — capture full output.
2. Run `zig build` — confirm build is green.
3. Map test results to TC-EE-05-01 through TC-EE-05-17 from `tests/specs/EE-05.md`.
4. Write report to `tests/reports/WF02-ee05-20260522-run-01.md` following the format in other EE run reports.

Report MUST include:
- Overall pass/fail count
- Per-test-case status (PASS / FAIL / SKIP-INTEGRATION)
- Any failure output verbatim
- Build exit code
acceptance_criteria: All TC-EE-05-01 through TC-EE-05-17 mapped to PASS/FAIL/SKIP
